designs.description: Clean lines, organic curves, and bold graphic elements from the 1950s-60s design era. Think Eames, Saul Bass, and Herb Lubalin. Geometric yet warm, structured yet playful.

designs.trendName: Swiss International Style — The mathematical precision of Josef Müller-Brockmann and Massimo Vignelli, sharpened for 2026's kinetic variable-font era. Strict baseline grids, asymmetric-yet-perfectly-balanced column compositions, and objective typographic hierarchy create an authority that lets the writing do the work — no decoration required. In the current award-gallery landscape, Swiss design's obsessive grid logic maps directly onto scroll-driven typographic animation and variable font manipulation, making it simultaneously timeless and the freshest structural choice of the year.
